name: Fireworks
source:
“Kiri’s master is Kenichi, and no one else—now and always.”

A “super” pure-love, orthodox maid novel presented by Rorichise.

Kenichi, the protagonist, was born into a distinguished family that had already fallen on hard times. He lived modestly with a small number of servants and his father, a musician. One winter day, a sudden fire struck the mansion. The house burned to the ground, and his father, unable to escape in time, died. The remaining inheritance was swindled away by relatives, leaving Kenichi penniless and cast out into the cold winter air.

Just when it seemed he had lost everything, Kiri—the maid who had been exclusively assigned to him—decided to share his fate. Though bewildered by a debt of gratitude he did not remember incurring and by her kindness, Kenichi accepts her goodwill.

Under one roof in a run-down apartment, a strange life together with his maid begins. Before long, that place becomes an irreplaceable world for the two of them.

—This world, as fleeting as fireworks, I will surely change its course.
translation:
“无论现在还是永远，雾的主人都只有健一少爷一人。”

由Rorichise献上的“超”纯爱王道女仆视觉小说。

男主角健一出身于早已家道中落的名门望族，与寥寥数名佣人以及身为音乐家的父亲过着简朴低调的生活。某个冬日，一场突如其来的大火席卷了宅邸。整座洋馆被烧成白地，来不及逃生的父亲也不幸葬身火海。残余的遗产又被亲戚巧取豪夺骗走，身无分文的健一就这样在凛冽寒冬中被扫地出门。

就在他看似失去一切的时候，一直担任他专属女仆的少女“雾”毅然决定与他共进退。面对那份自己毫无印象的“恩情”与她无微不至的体贴，健一虽困惑不已，最终还是接受了她的好意。

在一间破旧公寓的同一屋檐下，少年与女仆奇妙的同居生活就此开始。不知不觉间，这方小小的天地成了两人无可替代的全世界。

——这如烟火般转瞬即逝的世界，我定要亲手改写它的轨迹。
